atoms.exact_source_text: Every population increase creates named Citizen subjects with Records, Residence, and visible obligations.
atoms.normalized_claim: The named-population test requires every population increase to create named Citizen subjects with Records, Residence, and visible obligations.

atoms.exact_source_text: A mature Colony remains in the specified low dozens and concept art can depict the full social body.
atoms.normalized_claim: The scale test requires a mature Colony to remain in the specified low dozens such that concept art can depict the full social body.

atoms.exact_source_text: Roster, Home Presence, Available Civic Population, and Dependents / Patients remain distinguishable.

atoms.exact_source_text: Every present available adult contributes one equal Home Capacity regardless of personal aptitude.
atoms.normalized_claim: The capacity test requires every present available adult to contribute one equal Home Capacity regardless of personal aptitude.

atoms.exact_source_text: Adding population can create Thin Roles, Residence pressure, or seasonal obligation rather than functioning as pure gain.

atoms.exact_source_text: Early adult growth primarily arrives through named same-species Wanderers and reuses MEET rather than an amenability roll.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Wanderer test requires early adult growth to primarily arrive through named same-species Wanderers and to reuse MEET rather than an amenability roll.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Nursery cannot be optimized as a birth factory and multiple Nursery Places do not multiply output.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Nursery test requires that the Nursery cannot be optimized as a birth factory and multiple Nursery Places do not multiply output.

atoms.exact_source_text: Young count as full named population and Load before they provide Capacity.
atoms.normalized_claim: The young-Citizen test requires Young to count as full named population and Load before they provide Capacity.

atoms.exact_source_text: Guests count toward population and neutral Tier proofs without becoming mandatory.

atoms.exact_source_text: Population alone cannot advance Tier

atoms.exact_source_text: all six forms of civic evidence are required.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Tier-proof test requires all six forms of civic evidence.

atoms.exact_source_text: Population loss may destabilize the Colony but does not erase its earned Tier.
atoms.normalized_claim: The retention test requires that population loss may destabilize the Colony but does not erase its earned Tier.

atoms.exact_source_text: Tier III can support satisfying indefinite play without forced population growth or Tier IV pursuit.
atoms.normalized_claim: The plateau test requires that Tier III can support satisfying indefinite play without forced population growth or Tier IV pursuit.

atoms.exact_source_text: Tier IV reads as corridor connection, resilience, and legacy rather than factories, armies, or empire.

atoms.exact_source_text: Population in MEDIAN is the number of lives the Colony has chosen, inherited, rescued, raised, or welcomed - and can still meaningfully know.
atoms.normalized_claim: Population in MEDIAN is defined as the number of lives the Colony has chosen, inherited, rescued, raised, or welcomed, and can still meaningfully know.

atoms.exact_source_text: Wanderers give the founding survivors a people.
atoms.normalized_claim: Wanderers give the founding survivors a people.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Nursery makes later generations possible by asking the Colony to carry obligation before capacity.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Nursery makes later generations possible by asking the Colony to carry obligation before capacity.

atoms.exact_source_text: Guests enlarge citizenship through difference.
atoms.normalized_claim: Guests enlarge citizenship through difference.

atoms.exact_source_text: None are produced as anonymous labor.

atoms.exact_source_text: The four Colony Tiers measure the widening scale of that responsibility.
atoms.normalized_claim: The four Colony Tiers measure the widening scale of that responsibility.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Scavenger Camp proves it can survive.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Fortified Settlement learns to prepare.

atoms.exact_source_text: An Independent Colony can endure and choose.
